meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把品牌宣传片、混剪、标题卡和较长的多场景片段做成完整成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有一段或多段素材需要剪成完整的多场景视频成片。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assemble longer, multi-scene videos from existing footage.

howto.what: 当没有专门工作流匹配、或 BRIEF.md 里 flow 设为 companion 时，Claude 会用它编写或修改 HyperFrames 视频合成：多场景长片、品牌与宣传片、混剪、静态循环、静态标题卡、素材再剪辑等。
howto.when: 当没有专门的工作流匹配、或 BRIEF.md 里设了 flow: companion 时接管；想做全新的片子要先走 /hyperframes，再回到它。

say.text: 帮我做一个多场景的 30 秒品牌宣传片
say.note: 先出方案，再按流程搭建

say.text: 把这段素材剪成硬切混剪，顺序按我给的来
say.note: 通过复制片段并设置 data-start 实现

say.text: 在 BRIEF.md 里把 flow 设成 companion，边聊边做
say.note: 会先给出完整方案，由你删减

howto.what_en: When no specialized workflow fits, or BRIEF.md sets flow: companion, Claude authors or edits a HyperFrames composition: multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, or BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Fresh creation routes through /hyperframes first, then returns here.

say_en.text: Make a multi-scene 30-second brand sizzle reel
Cut this footage into a hard-cut montage in my order
Set flow to companion in BRIEF.md so we co-create
